_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No coil-breaker is visible (flat 30d price, funding near zero, ETF flows dead, mixed CVD/retail); base rate favors HOLD inside the Denial band until flows or fear_greed force a one-rung shift.
next_move.brains_agree: No—analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION in Denial; narrative outflow story implies accumulation bias without a clear forward phase/direction call; consensus stays HOLD per analyst weight and coil base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays flat, fear_greed holds 47-55 band, funding near zero, ETF flows remain dead
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks above 63 on renewed ETF-flow bid (one rung up toward Anxiety) or breaks below 47 as momentum and CVD roll over together (one rung down toward Panic)
